item.name: get spare parts profile form fields

request.description:
Request Body: Array of garage/shop images

photo_type: required  
Allowed values:  
GARAGE_FRONT | GARAGE_INTERIOR | SERVICE_BAY | PAINT_BOOTH |  
VEHICLE_LIFT | DENTING_AREA | ACCIDENT_REPAIR_AREA |  
EQUIPMENT | OTHER

object_key: required  
Type: string  
S3 object key returned after successful upload.

sort_order: optional  
Type: integer  
Minimum: 0

Example:

\[  
{  
"photo_type": "GARAGE_FRONT",  
"object_key": "vendor-applications/KVA-000001/garage-photos/front.webp",  
"sort_order": 1  
}  
\]
